list.searchPlaceholder: Chọọ site na ID onye mmekọ...
list.empty: Enweghị ndebanye aha dabara na nzacha ndị a.

override.title: Onye nchịkwa weghaara
override.hint: A na-eji njirimara onye nchịkwa gị na-abanye mgbe niile na ihe kpatara ya - agbachi nkịtị.
override.cancelBookingHint: Ịkagbu na-egosi ntinye akwụkwọ na ọrụ ya dị ka akagbuola, na-eweghachi onye ya na ya na-arụ ọrụ nwe, ma hapụ onye nrụpụta akwụkwọ ka ọ bụrụ ụzọ ọzọ.
override.cancelBookingConfirm: Kagbuo ntinye akwụkwọ a? A kagbuola ọrụ ya. Edebanye aha a na ihe kpatara ya.

detail.disputeOpen: Esemokwu nwe meghere onye ahịa a - onye ọzọ na-ekwu na ọ bụ nke ha. A na-ekpebi ya na ibe esemokwu.

cancellation.title: Kagbuo ntinye akwụkwọ
cancellation.hint: A kagbuola ntinye akwụkwọ na ọrụ ya; Onye nwe ya na onye ya na ya na-arụkọ ọrụ alaghachila ma onye na-ewu ụlọ nwere ike idebe ụzọ a ọzọ.

disputes.title: Esemokwu Nwe
disputes.hint: Onye mmekọ jụrụ ndebanye aha ya dị ka oyiri nwere ike ịrụ ụka onye nwe onye ahịa. Nyochaa akụkụ abụọ ahụ wee kpebie.

detail.title: Esemokwu {{id}}
detail.heldMissing: Enweghị ike ịchọta ndebanye aha ejidere.
detail.upholdEffect: {{holder}} na-edobe onye ahịa. A na-emechi esemokwu ahụ ma ọ dịghị ihe ọzọ gbanwere.
detail.overturnEffect: Nchedo oyiri nke {{holder}} kwụsịrị ugbu a yana onye ahịa debanyere aha maka {{partner}} ka ndebanye aha ọhụrụ.
